043package dev.visdb.seesaw;
044
045import java.lang.System.Logger;
046import java.lang.System.Logger.Level;
047import java.sql.JDBCType;
048import java.sql.SQLException;
049import java.util.EnumSet;
050import java.util.EventListener;
051
052import javax.swing.JSlider;
053import javax.swing.event.ChangeEvent;
054import javax.swing.event.ChangeListener;
055
056import dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.RowsModel;
057import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff;
058import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsComponent;
059import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsUtils;
060
061import static dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.ConvertType.assertConvertFromJdbcType;
062import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff.sf;
063import static java.sql.JDBCType.*;
064
065/**
066 * Used to link a JSlider to a numeric column in a database.
067 */
068@SuppressWarnings("serial")
069public class SsSlider extends JSlider implements SsComponent {
070  /**
071   * Listener(s) for the component's value used to propagate changes back to bound
072   * text field.
073   */
074  protected class SliderListener implements ChangeListener {
075    /** {@inheritDoc } */
076    @Override
077    public void stateChanged(ChangeEvent ce) {
078      // While adjusting don't need to update the database.
079      if (getValueIsAdjusting())
080        return;
081
082      try {
083        dbChange(() -> setColumnObject(getValue()));
084      } catch (SQLException ex) {
085        logger.log(Level.ERROR, (String) null, ex);
086      }
087    }
088
089  } // end protected class SliderListener implements ChangeListener, Serializable
090
091  /** Logger for component */
092  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
093
094  /**
095   * Empty constructor needed for deserialization. Creates a horizontal slider
096   * with the range 0 to 100.
097   */
098  public SsSlider() {
099    finishSsCommon();
100  }
101
102  /**
103   * Creates a slider using the specified orientation with the range 0 to 100.
104   *
105   * @param orientation slider spatial orientation
106   */
107  public SsSlider(int orientation) {
108    super(orientation);
109    finishSsCommon();
110  }
111
112  /**
113   * Creates a horizontal slider using the specified min and max.
114   *
115   * @param min minimum slider value
116   * @param max maximum slider value
117   */
118  public SsSlider(int min, int max) {
119    super(min, max);
120    finishSsCommon();
121  }
122
123  /**
124   * Creates a horizontal slider with the range 0 to 100 and binds it to the
125   * specified RowSet column.
126   *
127   * @param rowsModel          datasource to be used.
128   * @param columnName name of the column to which this slider should be
129   *                         bound
130   * @throws java.sql.SQLException SQLException
131   */
132  public SsSlider(RowsModel rowsModel, String columnName) throws java.sql.SQLException {
133    this();
134    rowsModel.bind(this, columnName);
135  }
136
137  /** {@inheritDoc } */
138  @Override
139  public void checkColumnType(JDBCType jdbcType) throws IllegalArgumentException {
140    // only allow JDBC types that convert to numeric types
141    assertConvertFromJdbcType(
142        jdbcType, Integer.class,
143        EnumSet.of(INTEGER, SMALLINT, TINYINT, BIGINT, REAL, FLOAT, DOUBLE, DECIMAL, NUMERIC));
144  }
145
146  /** {@inheritDoc } */
147  @Override
148  public void cleanField() {
149    // SsSlider to the middle.
150    setValue((getMinimum() + getMaximum()) / 2);
151  }
152
153  private Hook hook;
154
155  /** {@inheritDoc } */
156  @Override
157  public final Hook getSsComponentHook() {
158    if (hook == null)
159      hook = new Hook(this) {
160        /** {@inheritDoc } */
161        @Override
162        protected void updateSsComponent() {
163          try {
164            Integer n = getColumnObject(Integer.class);
165            setValue(n != null ? n : 0);
166          } catch (final NumberFormatException _nfe) {
167            // TODO: Hmm, probably should be an SQL conversion error.
168            // Output the text value
169            String columnValue = getColumnText();
170            logger.log(Level.ERROR,
171                       getColumnForLog() + ": Number Format Exception. Cannot update slider to "
172                           + columnValue,
173                       _nfe);
174          }
175        }
176
177        /** {@inheritDoc } */
178        @Override
179        protected SliderListener getSsComponentListener() {
180          return new SliderListener();
181        }
182
183        /** {@inheritDoc } */
184        @Override
185        protected void addSsComponentListener(EventListener eventListener) {
186          addChangeListener((ChangeListener) eventListener);
187        }
188
189        /** {@inheritDoc } */
190        @Override
191        protected void removeSsComponentListener(EventListener eventListener) {
192          removeChangeListener((ChangeListener) eventListener);
193        }
194      };
195    return hook;
196  }
197
198  /** {@inheritDoc} */
199  @Override
200  public String toString() {
201    return sf("%s{value=%s, %s}", getClass().getSimpleName(), getValue(),
202              SsUtils.ssComponentToString(this));
203  }
204} // end public class SsSlider extends JSlider
